verdict.rationale: Docs confirm Claude is available on Google Vertex AI with an API nearly identical to the native Messages API (claude-docs-63), showing multi-cloud distribution beyond Anthropic's own endpoint. However, the evidence pack contains no mention of AWS Bedrock, Azure, or OpenRouter-class gateway support, so the full breadth of the story is unconfirmed here. Missing for 10: documented Bedrock availability, Azure availability, OpenRouter/gateway compatibility, and independent corroboration of parity across these platforms.
